steps.text:
BOARDING
Go to the back of your Nomad

Hold the walking arrows; drag the view to look. Go around the outside of the hull to the rear ramp, behind the engines.

BOARDING
Open your Nomad's rear hatch

Tap the interaction button to open the hatch and lower the ramp.

BOARDING
Close the hatch behind you

Tap the interaction button to close the hatch and raise the ramp.

BOARDING
Sit in the pilot chair

Tap the interaction button to take the controls.

DEPARTURE
Lift off from the station pad

Tap Launch to take off. Wait for the short automatic lift.

DEPARTURE
Retract your landing gear

Open Commands → Ship → Landing gear (use the page arrows if needed) to stow the legs. Gear down limits you to maneuvering speed.

DEPARTURE
Fly out through the hangar doors

Hold the forward flight control to move out of the bay. Keep the ship level until you are clear of the station.

YOUR NEXT JOURNEY
Choose what to do next

Open Commands → Map to select a destination, or open Commands → Contracts to choose a contract.

APPROACH
Fly toward Patrol signal

Drag the view to centre its marker. Hold the forward flight control to approach; hold Brake to slow down near it.

input: Native CDP touch contacts; no keyboard or gameplay state mutation
